dispatch: Only resident LOS calls with total<=32 rays, referenced triangles>=8192, complete reachable tree height<=32 and a cut of8..32 branches use one warp per ray. Others retain original LOS kernels; reflection unchanged.
semantics: Retain every ancestor AABB test, exact FP64 direction/intersection expressions, original per-subtree DFS and single/batch edge behavior. Proven shallow height avoids legacy stack truncation. Warp OR changes independent traversal scheduling, not LOS classification or reflection/model.
